'''Skazz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]] he was hired by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] to murder the head of [[Corellian Security Force]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] captured the Black Sun [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Tessa Wylden]] for [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' second in command, [[Irenez (Twi'lek)|Irenez]] learned about Skazz's mission. The spacer agreed to help Irenez and succeeded in intercepting and killing Skazz.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Skazz]]
Skazz was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was part of a mission given out by Irenez in [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] that required the player to travel to a place outside the city and kill Skazz. In 2005 the NPCs Garm Bel Iblis and Irenez were removed from the game and the quest involving Skazz was therefore no longer available.

Due to the way such quests were designed by the developers, the appearance, gender and species of the NPC are different each time a player runs the mission. Therefore there's no canonical description of the character's look and species, while his sex is mentioned by Irenez and therefore canon.
